# Noobot v4.3.5

This release restores script tool responses, resolves server-side and client-side locking issues, optimizes the codebase, and fixes bugs.

- Restore reliable output and result propagation from script tools.
- Fix session and file mutation locking under concurrent operations.
- Fix client-side locking across windows and runtime operations.
- Improve Session persistence, cleanup, and connector selection reliability.
- Optimize runtime, protocol, service, and client code paths.
- Fix regressions affecting execution and state consistency.
